description.narrative: To provide financial support a local people living with HIV organization to increase HIV treatment literacy among PLHIV, combated HIV stigma, empower adolescents and young women and men living with HIV, and conduct advocacy for PLHIV issues and improved enabling environment for the national HIV response.
